encoder.parse_failure_policy: preserve row; existing deterministic zero raw embedding and parse_mask=false; never delete or hand-edit prediction
encoder.actual_code_identity: actual reviewed scientific implementation at execution; record full source hashes and semantic mapping, no legacy-byte equality claim

train.per_file_sha_status: registered in SRC-SCAFFOLD input_hashes; host must match actual approved train file before use; not a new download

split.algorithm: codepoint-sort unique keys; CPython random.Random(43).shuffle; take whole groups until >= max(1,round(0.1*n)) rows, never consume all groups; preserve row order
split.one_class_or_constant_metric_policy: fail task preparation; no seed search or metric substitution; redesign requires explicit review

feature_preprocessing.nonfinite_raw_features: abort; parse failure zeros are explicit, not arbitrary NaN imputation

target.physical_units: not inferred; supplied numeric Y scale
target.prediction_scale: original supplied Y, inverse affine exactly once

head.initializer: torch.nn.Linear reset_parameters defaults; common seed makes H0/H1 initial tensors identical

training.sampler: CPU torch.Generator seeded by fixed model_seed
training.python_numpy_torch_seed: same scalar model_seed for each expanded run
training.unsupported_nondeterministic_op: fail acceptance; do not silently downgrade

early_stopping.definition: Pearson correlation of average tied ranks
early_stopping.undefined_or_nonfinite: stop and flag; do not substitute zero

artifacts.prediction_export_precision: float64 serialization of finite outputs; unchanged template metadata
artifacts.save_test_predictions_when: this controller task authorizes all selected task test rows after best-head reload, no test labels or fitting

evaluation.primary_selection_dataset: inner_stop_train_only; optimistic screening proxy, not official-valid score
evaluation.official_valid_scope: aggregate feedback only through authorized host evaluator; no new scoring in this research
evaluation.selection_claim: screening signal only, not independent generalization estimate
evaluation.normalization: none; task metric only; no inferred official aggregate formula
evaluation.official_valid_feedback_schedule: design frozen for all 24 fits; designated retrieval role scores once per fit after independent acceptance; trainer never receives row labels
